text:
emma.partnerships: quick go-live checkin for Identity Fabric connector (SCIM + SSO + KMS) — target next Tue. can ppl confirm readiness items? :raised_hands:
raj.security: list what you have now, emma. I need SAML metadata, SCIM attribute map, and HSM key policy draft by EOD Thu.
maria.product: rollout plan: canary on Dedicated region us-west-2 for 24h, then 25% traffic for 48h, full after SLA checks. Need a rollback tag.
emma.partnerships: ok — summary: (1) SAML metadata (2) SCIM mapping doc (3) KMS/HSM provisioning + access policy (4) marketplace listing draft (5) joint announcement assets + embargo date
suyash.si_pm: integrator side: connector v1.2 built, passes functional tests. We still need customer SCIM attrs mapping for displayName/email/roles. Also require test service account with scoped KMS key.
oliver.sre: staging smoke checklist: auth flow test (SAML), SCIM user create/update/delete, secret fetch latency <50ms for 95th. Can we add a synthetic test?
jenna.marketing: embargo window preferred Tue 09:00 PT. We need partner logo, short blurb, 2 screenshots, and a quote from partner PM by Mon EOD.
carol.legal: will review partner terms + marketplace contract. if there are any customer data flow diagrams include them. flag: ensure we don't surface HSM attestation docs publicly.
raj.security: For HSM/KMS: provide key policy template below and a thumbprint for the HSM cert. We need to approve the CSR before customer key is provisioned.
raj.security: ```
# minimal key policy example
{
  "principal": "service:connector@redwood",
  "actions": ["encrypt","decrypt","sign"],
  "resource": "projects/*/kms/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*"
}
```
emma.partnerships: Suyash, can you post example SCIM mapping file? we can adapt.
suyash.si_pm: posted sample mapping in our GH, paste here quick: {"externalId":"id","userName":"email","name.givenName":"firstName","name.familyName":"lastName","groups":"roles"}
maria.product: add a note: groups->roles mapping must be a list; we need to document expected role names for RBAC.
oliver.sre: who owns canary routing config? I can set the traffic steering but need the route and model/version pin. provide model tag before weekend.
emma.partnerships: model pinned to rf/identity-connector:2026-03-10-canary. i'll push the tag.
jenna.marketing: quick ask — partner wants a joint webinar. proposed date Thu 2 weeks out. Marketing to coordinate with partner comms.
carol.legal: also request a statement about data residency for marketplace listing (EU customers). send the exact language you want on the listing.
raj.security: one more: run HSM attestation check and attach result to the runbook. integrator must provide cert chain and attestation token.
suyash.si_pm: integrator will generate CSR by tomorrow; need to know who signs (Redwood ops or partner CA?).
oliver.sre: ops will sign temporary cert for staging only. production must be signed by partner's HSM CA or our KM SAT-approved CA.
emma.partnerships: action items: emma -> coordinate partner assets + publish marketplace draft; raj -> security docs + key policy; maria -> canary plan + runbook; oliver -> staging tests and routing; su yash -> provide SCIM sample + CSR; carol -> legal review; jenna -> embargo + webinar comms. I'll update tracker. :clipboard:
integrations-bot: deploy-check: connector v1.2 build 448 passed CI, staging image pushed to gcr://redwood/identity-connector:staging-448 — smoke pipeline queued.
emma.partnerships: thanks. if no blockers let's aim for next Tue go-live window 09:00-11:00 PT. any last objections?
raj.security: no objections, but hold on any public announcement until attestation + legal sign-off.
jenna.marketing: noted — we'll hold embargo until legal thumbs-up.
emma.partnerships: cool. i'll ping again once docs are in. :tada:
